author: Warren
text:
Hello all,

Passing through and wanted to wish you all a Merry Christmas and a prosperous New Year.

I hope you are learning lots from this forum, it certainly made me consider who was at work in the trading arena. Knuckle down and make 2015 your year, you owe it to yourself.

When the mist begins to lift you will see trading for what it is and understand that it has been you making it difficult. If you want to really understand trading, you must first look in the mirror.

Best Wishes
